versions.changelog:
Initial release of image-to-3d skill.

- Enables creation of 3D mesh assets (such as GLB) from a single input image using a zero-setup hosted runtime.
- Does not require provider credentials, OAuth, or local runtime.
- Keeps job history, asset URLs, receipts, payments, and feedback in one workflow loop.
- Shared contract and workflow with the canonical image-skill; intended as a specialized entry point for agents requesting image-to-3D asset generation.
